review:
Pearl Harbor is a 7x7 historical war slot where only part of the grid starts active. Target symbols expand the active area, and scatters only count inside it. xBomb Wilds blow up as many as ten surrounding symbols.

xSplit and xCluster add more ways to build wins. Nolimit rates it Extreme volatility, with a 41,127x cap. The real-world theme won't suit everyone.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
